channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Check Point
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Check Point, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Keep patched: Check Point Quantum (several versions): Heap-based Buffer Overflow in VPN Certificate ASN.1 Decoding
item.description:
Check Point Quantum (several versions): Memory corruption (possible RCE) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · check vendor

First step: Follow the vendor advisory for the affected Check Point products: install the update or apply the mitigation it lists.

A heap-based buffer overflow in VPN certificate ASN.1 decoding may allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on Check Point Quantum Security Management and Quantum Security Gateway systems.

Critical · Check vendor · CVE-2026-85103

item.title: Keep patched: Check Point (multiple products): 2 flaws exploited together
item.description:
Check Point (multiple products): Path traversal (file read/write) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: R81.10.17, R82.00.10, R81.10

First step: Update the affected Check Point products to the fixed version for your release line (for example R81.10.17, R82.00.10 or R81.10).

Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway. CISA lists 1 more flaw in Check Point (multiple products) as exploited on the same day (CVE-2026-93616).

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-85102, CVE-2026-93616
